description: One-time pass: 25 successful calls shared across supported single-domain tools, valid 30 days and independent of IP. Excludes private lookup, quote redemption and paid email inboxes. Takes one active Base wallet or a work email (no email is sent). The pass goes in the X-Trial-Token header or MCP metadata hirepulse/trial_token.

inputSchema.description: Provide exactly one of wallet or email, never both. The server validates eligibility before issuing a trial.

email.description: A work email address; free mailbox providers are not accepted.

wallet.description: A Base address with at least one transaction or $0.10 USDC.

name: claim_free_trial

outputSchema.description: Fields only; full schema in GET /v1/catalog.

trial_token.description: Secret bearer capability. Keep private; never publish or log.

title: Claim a free 25-call trial
